description: Laajakaistan saatavuus Varsinais-Suomessa 2009 is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Varsinais-Suomen liitto. Laajakaista kaikille -hankkeen kaupallisen alueen rajaus Varsinais-Suomessa. Aineisto on tuotettu vuonna 2009 Varsinais-Suomen liitossa laajakaistan saavutettavuuden analysointiin. Aineistossa myös pääteiden mukaisen runkoverkon puskurivyöhykkeet ja tarjousalueet. Aineisto on siirretty Lounaistiedon dataportaalista. Coverage: Varsinais-Suomen liitto. The publisher named on the listing is Varsinais-Suomen liitto. Its keywords include saavutettavuus, laajakaistaverkot, Lounaistieto. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
